data.title: PSG confirm another devastating, season-ending injury
data.content:
Desire Doue went off injured against Nice yesterday afternoon, looking in great pain. Today, the club have confirmed everyone’s worst fears – the attack has ruptured the ACL in his right knee.

The Parisians were already without Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, who suffered the same injury a month ago. Losing one world class attacker was bad, but the quality the team have in attack meant it wasn’t an impossible objective. [...] Now, without two of them, the season looks very different. Ligue 1 is still of course likely to be a cruise as it so often is. But the chances of a third consecutive Champions League have dropped precipitously.

## PSG new arrivals must step up earlier than expected

PSG added Mika Godts and Maghnes Akliouche in attack this summer. They were expected to be worked in gradually, but both will now be playing in almost every game now. [...] PSG have lost another one of their key players to injury, with devastating news about Desire Doue coming out this afternoon.
